question: Who has been nominated by President Droupadi Murmu to the Rajya Sabha in January 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Satnam Singh Sandhu**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• President nominated Satnam Singh Sandhu to Rajya Sabha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **President Droupadi Murmu nominated Satnam Singh Sandhu to the Rajya Sabha**, as per a notification from the home ministry.
 
• Satnam Singh Sandhu, the **founder-chancellor of Chandigarh University**, is known as one of India's leading educationists and social workers.
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi expressed his delight at Sandhu's nomination, highlighting his contributions to education and community service.
 
• Vice President and Rajya Sabha Chairperson **Shri Jagdeep Dhankhar** also welcomed Sandhu's nomination, emphasizing his passion for education, innovation, and community service.
 
• Sandhu's journey from a farmer's son to an eminent educationist has been marked by his dedication to creating world-class educational institutions and his philanthropic endeavors to support students in pursuing quality education.
 
• His nomination to the Rajya Sabha reflects his significant contributions to education, innovation, and national integration.
